name: Athens
line: Athens was a famous Greek city full of idols, where Paul reasoned with philosophers and told the Athenians about the God who made the world.

moments.title: Paul sees the idols
moments.text: Paul waits in Athens for Silas and Timothy. He is deeply disturbed in his spirit to see that the city is full of idols.

moments.title: Paul speaks at the Areopagus
moments.text: Philosophers bring Paul to the Areopagus to explain his new teaching. He tells them about an altar TO AN UNKNOWN GOD and proclaims the God who made the world and gives everyone life and breath. Some believe.

moments.title: Paul sends Timothy to Thessalonica
moments.text: Paul writes that when they could bear it no longer, they were willing to be left on their own in Athens. They sent Timothy to strengthen and encourage the believers in their faith.

moments.title: Paul leaves for Corinth
moments.text: After this, Paul leaves Athens and goes to Corinth.
